description:
Core no longer contains Sphinx or the site (#3096), and benchbox.dev is served by the Astro build in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site. The site split copied files that the build no longer uses. One site PR and one core PR remove them.

benchbox-site:
- Delete the unserved static pages and scripts: landing/index.html, landing/script.js, landing/style.css, landing/prompts/index.html, landing/prompts/prompts.js, landing/prompts/catalog.generated.js and landing/prompts/catalog.yaml (the catalog now comes from the bundle's landing/prompt-catalog.json).
- Delete landing/shared/site-header.css, site-header.js and site-theme.js, used only by the deleted pages.
- Retire the second theme file: move the two variables landing/prompts/prompts.css reads from landing/shared/site-theme.css (--bb-site-header-cta-text, --warning-color) into site-tokens.css, then drop site-theme.css and its import in website/src/styles/landing-theme.css.
- Point the explorer/e2e/routes/header.spec.ts "static surface" tests at the built / and /prompts/ pages, or delete them in favour of website/tests/shell.test.ts; today they read the deleted files.
- Remove the legacy old-vs-new comparison from website/e2e/landing.mjs (LANDING_DIR / OLD_BASE_URL).
- Keep files the build imports: landing/shared/site-tokens.css, site-shell.css, landing/prompts/prompts.css, landing/hero.png (they may move to a neutral path, updating explorer/src/index.css, Shell.astro, astro.config.ts and tests).
- Remove the Sphinx-era parity data only website/scripts/id-parity.ts reads (inventory/baseline-develop/, expected-removals-*.json, added-paths.json, allowed-inventory-losses.json) and id-parity.ts itself; remove scripts/shadow-compare.mjs, inventory/shadow-allowlist.json and their AGENTS.md mention. Keep inventory/known-broken-links.json and anything the build, deploy or CI still reads.

core:
- Remove the docs/_templates HTML adapter in scripts/comment_syntax.py (around line 172) and its tests in tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py.
- Replace the docs/_extensions/sphinx_tags_fix.py fixture in tests/unit/scripts/test_path_filter_decision.py with a path that exists.
- Delete the unused docs/linkcheck_ignore.txt.
- Correct the Sphinx pipeline sketch in docs/internal/benchbox-results-platform-strategy.md.
- Mark _project/decisions/adr-astro-unified-site.md as partly superseded by docs/internal/adr/adr-site-repo-split.md, and re-point the links in _project/decisions/astro-api-reference-contract.md to the copy of api-reference-url-map.json in benchbox-site inventory/.

Out of scope: make/monolith-baseline.json (frozen history) and core landing/prompts/catalog.yaml (the bundle's catalog source). The MyST converter decision stays with site-myst-converter-retirement-20261017.
